step1_analysis.description: A digitally controlled delay line cell consisting of a current-starved inverter followed by a standard inverter buffer. The delay is monotonically adjusted by switching PMOS current sources (controlled by digital inputs A, B, D) that modulate the bias voltage of the current-starved inverter.

paper_reference.title: A Monotonic Digitally Controlled Delay Element

delay_max.description: Maximum propagation delay when all digital control bits are OFF (A=1, B=1, D=1), resulting in minimum bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Intrinsic delay of the current-starved inverter + standard inverter buffer. In 130nm, with a 10fF load and minimum bias current (~70uA), delay is approximately C*V/I = 10fF * 0.9V / 70uA + intrinsic delays.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be slightly faster or comparable to the 0.18um process depending on the exact bias voltage applied to N11.

delay_min.description: Minimum propagation delay when all digital control bits are ON (A=0, B=0, D=0), resulting in maximum bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay with maximum bias current (~180uA). C*V/I = 10fF * 0.9V / 180uA + intrinsic delays.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the ~10% tuning range reported in the paper.

delay_resolution.description: The change in delay per LSB of the digital control input.

sky130_expected.calculation: (delay_max - delay_min) / number_of_states. With 3 bits (assuming thermometer or equal weight), resolution is roughly 39ps / 3.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 'as low as 2ps', likely using more bits in the full implementation. For this 3-bit schematic, it will be around 10-15ps.

power_max.description: Maximum static power consumption when all control branches are ON.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VN11=1.0V, Vsg=0.8V, each PMOS branch provides ~36uA. 5 branches = 180uA. 1.8V * 180uA = 324uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly matches the paper's reported maximum power by tuning the analog bias VN11 to 1.0V.

power_min.description: Minimum static power consumption when all control branches are OFF.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_base. Base current is 2 branches (XM1, XM10) = 72uA. 1.8V * 72uA = 130uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported minimum power.

tuning_range.description: Percentage of delay variation relative to the maximum delay.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the paper's reported 359ps and 320ps values ((359-320)/359 = 10.8%).

step3_testbench.description: Measures maximum/minimum delay, delay resolution, and static power consumption across different digital input states to verify monotonicity and performance.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Monotonic Digitally Controlled Delay Element
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm19=5u L_xm19=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VG N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VG VG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM13 OUT N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM4 VG VG N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N7 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N11 N11 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N8 VG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 VG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 VG B N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 IN N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM3 N3 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM14 OUT N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N5 IN N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N4 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N10 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 VG A N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM19 VG D N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm19} w={W_xm19}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN11 N11 0 1.0
VIN IN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VA A 0 DC 1.8
VB B 0 DC 1.8
VD D 0 DC 1.8

* Load
CL OUT 0 10f

.control
  * State 0: All OFF (Max Delay)
  alter @VA[dc] = 1.8
  alter @VB[dc] = 1.8
  alter @VD[dc] = 1.8
  op
  let power_min = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran delay_max trig v(in) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.9 rise=1

  * State 1: 1 ON (Mid Delay)
  alter @VD[dc] = 0
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran delay_mid trig v(in) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.9 rise=1

  * State 3: All ON (Min Delay)
  alter @VA[dc] = 0
  alter @VB[dc] = 0
  op
  let power_max = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran delay_min trig v(in) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.9 rise=1
  
  let delay_resolution = delay_max - delay_mid
  let tuning_range = (delay_max - delay_min) / delay_max * 100
  
  print delay_max delay_min delay_resolution power_min power_max tuning_range
  quit
.endc
